_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Supply Chain Management (SCM) Data
summary: Specifies the format and content requirements for Supply Chain Management data, including Bill of Materials information, delivered to support DoD Total System Life Cycle Management activities.
use_relationship:
Data delivered using this Data Item Description (DID) will be used to support Supply Chain Management activities. Those activities may require collecting Bill of Materials data as a part of the Department of Defense's (DoD) Total System Life Cycle Management responsibilities. The data may be obtained during any life cycle phase. The word "item" is used throughout the document to refer to anything in the system and includes parts, software, materials, chemicals, raw materials, etc.

This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data product resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.

Bill of Materials (BOM) data can be used to establish the production status of items used in a system. The BOM will also provide Program managers with essential information that enables the identification, mitigation, and management of hardware and software production, demand, capacity, throughput and obsolescence. The data will be used in industrial base illumination, demand, capacity, and capability modeling as well as enable standard and efficient sharing of information on common items.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Supply Chain Management Data shall be provided in tabular format with the Field Names in Table 1 as the column labels. The data shall be provided as an electronically editable, machine-readable, Comma Separated Values (CSV) text file with text fields enclosed in double quotation marks.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The data shall contain the information specified by the contract as referenced by the Data Element Numbers in Table 1. The data shall meet the requirements as specified in the Definition, Notes and Instructions, and Data Type columns of Table 1. The indentured path to the system level shall be identified using the item/Next Higher Assembly (NHA) method detailed in Table 1. All fields designated by the contract shall be included. Fields for which data is not available and which are not designated as "Required" in the Notes and Instructions column of Table 1 shall be left blank. The data shall be included to the lowest indenture level (component level) for all items, including subcontractor items, which are not commercial items.
